title: Malachi — Instructions and Commands
content:
Malachi — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

10 additional passage records · 11 quoted verse units. Read Malachi in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Uncertain · 2 passage records

Malachi 1:4

Record type: Prophetic instruction or reported speech. Source section: I Have Loved You, Says the Lord.

Malachi 1:4 — Because Idumea will say, “It has been overthrown; let us return and rebuild the deserted places,” thus says the Lord Almighty: “They will build, but I will overthrow. They will be called ‘Territories of Lawlessness’ and ‘A People Against Whom the Lord Has Drawn Up His Forces Forever.’”

Context and scope: Distinguish the prophet’s commission, covenant exhortation, quoted human speech and judgment rhetoric. Application beyond the original addressee remains open unless evidence is supplied.

Record type: Prophetic instruction or reported speech. Source section: Where Is My Honor?.

Malachi 1:9 — “And now appease the face of your God and plead with Him. These things have happened in your hands. Will I show favor to any of you?” says the Lord Almighty.
